errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.

connections.title: Connected accounts
connections.description: Connect your social accounts once. You log in on each network's own page and approve access; we never see your password.
connections.disconnectBody: You can connect it again at any time. Scheduled posts for this network may fail.
connections.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
connections.popupOpen: Finish connecting in the window that opened. This page updates when you close it.
connections.notAvailable: This network isn't set up for this service yet.

instagram.requirement: An Instagram professional account (Business or Creator).
instagram.rules: Feed (4:5 to 1.91:1), Reels and Stories in 9:16. Reels 3s to 15min, Stories up to 60s. Max 2,200 characters, 5 hashtags, 3 mentions. Stories need a Business account.

facebook.rules: Posts with up to 10 images or one video. Reels: 9:16, 3 to 90s. Stories: 9:16, video up to 60s.

tiktok.requirement: Personal or business TikTok account. Re-authorize once a year.
tiktok.rules: One 9:16 video (3s to 10min) or up to 35 JPG photos. Max 2,200 characters. Choose who can see the post.

linkedin.requirement: Your personal LinkedIn profile. LinkedIn asks you to reconnect every 60 days.
linkedin.rules: Text, up to 9 images, or one video. Max 3,000 characters. 'Connections only' works on personal profiles.

whatsapp.requirement: WhatsApp Business number. Messages to contacts only.
whatsapp.setup: WhatsApp is set up by our team after Meta approves your business number.
whatsapp.rules: Send a message with optional photos or videos to specific contacts.
whatsapp.noStatus: WhatsApp Status can't be published. WhatsApp doesn't allow it through its API.
whatsapp.window: A contact gets your message only if they wrote to you in the last 24 hours.
whatsapp.noSchedule: Messages are sent right away and can't be scheduled.

media.drop: Drag photos and videos here, or click to choose
media.hint: JPG, PNG, MP4 or MOV. Files go straight to secure storage.
media.rejected_one: {{count}} file was skipped (unsupported type or too large).
media.rejected_other: {{count}} files were skipped (unsupported type or too large).

auth.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
auth.welcomeDescription: Set a password to activate your account.
auth.resetDescription: Your old password stops working and other devices are signed out.
auth.passwordHelp: At least {{min}} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

about.title: What is Blakrasocial?
about.body: Blakrasocial, by {{company}}, lets businesses write a post once and publish or schedule it to their own Instagram professional account, Facebook Page, TikTok account and LinkedIn profile.
about.control: Each account is connected through the network's own sign-in page and can be disconnected at any time. Nothing is posted unless the user presses Publish or schedules the post.
about.access: Accounts are created by invitation for our customers.

admin.title: Customers
admin.description: Create accounts and send each customer their personal set-password link. Every account has its own connections and posts.
admin.newCustomerHelp: You get a link to send to the person yourself (email, WhatsApp…). It works once, for 7 days.
admin.name: Name
admin.exists: An account with this email already exists.
admin.linkHelp: Send this link only to this person. It works once and expires in {{days}} days.
admin.disableHelp: They are signed out everywhere and can't sign in until you enable the account again. Scheduled posts stay scheduled.
admin.whatsappHelp: From Meta's WhatsApp Manager: the phone number ID and a permanent System User token with whatsapp_business_messaging. The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.
admin.deleteHelp: This removes the account, its connected social accounts, scheduled and past posts, and uploaded files. Posts already published on the networks stay there. This cannot be undone.
